format.coordinates: pixels relative to actor foot/origin pivot; +x right, +y down. Add cell_pivot_px for cell coordinates. Montreur coordinates exclude game lift. Frame indices zero based; impact frame N/2 (2 slash/throw, 3 summon). throw_ult impact at zero-based frame 3.
format.montreur_animation: pull for spin/lift/summon/throw/throw_ult, hover otherwise; index = Rictus frame modulo companion frame count
format.spin: one row e; reuse spin_e for any facing
